artworks.title: Hovel on a Hillside (Masure sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a thatched-roof structure on the right side, with a low horizon and a spacious landscape stretching into the distance. Detailed etching highlights textures of the roof, bushes, and a tree near the structure. The style includes delicate lines emphasizing structural details. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and black shades for a timeless look. In the background, an open field is visible to the left, with subtle markings suggesting vegetation or terrain. The sky is vast and lightly etched, complementing the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hovel on a Hillside (Masure sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is of a landscape seen from a slightly elevated point of view. A thatched-roof structure is depicted on the right, partially obscured by shading and detailed in fine, crosshatched lines alongside foliage. The horizon is low, emphasizing the vast sky with wispy clouds styled in swirling patterns. Fields extending into the distance dotted with foliage are visible in the background. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of soft grays and sepia tones created with various pencil strokes to depict texture and depth. The result is a serene, rural landscape captured through a delicate and detailed drawing technique.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the base of a wooded area, looking upward through towering trees. The horizon is not visible, obscured by dense foliage and trees on both sides. In the distance, a building with a sloping roof is partially visible through the trees. The etching technique used intricate cross-hatching and fine lines to depict leaves, branches, and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. Light and shadow play across the scene, adding depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall trees in the foreground, their trunks and foliage captured in detailed lines. In the distance, a structure resembling a castle or fortress emerges from the trees. The artist uses hatching and cross-hatching to create shades and depict light filtering through the canopy. The color palette is sepia, providing a vintage feel. The composition leads the viewer's eye from the forest floor to the distant building.

artworks.title: Seated Beggar (Mendiant assis)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a seated man, captured from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the left, with his head tilted back and gaze directed upward. The man has a prominent nose, closed eyes, full beard and mustache, short hair, and is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with a vest. His hands are in his lap, with one hand holding a round, flat object, perhaps a hat. The background is a textured wall with cross-hatched shading, suggesting indoor lighting casting shadows.

artworks.title: Study of an Old Man (Etude de vieillard)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a three-quarter view, with a full beard and curly hair. He is wearing a collared garment that drapes around his shoulders. The background is textured, and the portrait is signed by A. Legros in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a lower perspective looking up at a dense cluster of trees and foliage with structures visible among the greenery. The horizon line is low in the composition, obscured by the trees. The etched lines and cross-hatching technique create shadows and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and brown on a cream background. The details of the buildings among the trees are less distinct.

artworks.title: Farm (Une ferme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rustic buildings and surrounding vegetation viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, with the sky occupying most of the space above the buildings. The structures appear to be houses with steeply pitched roofs, enveloped by trees and shrubs. The etching uses fine lines and cross-hatching techniques for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with variations of black and white. Linear strokes suggest a transition from the foreground grassy area to the wooded background.

artworks.title: Old Inn (Une ancienne auberge)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a wooden structure resembling a shed or barn in the foreground, a horse near a person, and a variety of trees and shrubs in the background. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and architectural structures, and the composition conveys a sense of depth with varying line styles depicting the elements. The etching's color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and black shades to emphasize texture and shadow via intricate linework and hatching.

artworks.title: Farm in Winter (Une ferme en hiver)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with buildings, trees, and a hill. The composition is made with intricate etching, featuring fine lines to depict textures and forms. The color scheme is primarily black lines on a cream background. The foreground has a rough, textured appearance with a path leading to the buildings and trees. Details are rendered with cross-hatched lines to suggest depth and shadow. The background fades softly, with a clear sky at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Harvesters (Les moissoneurs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features an etching depicting a rural scene from a side view. In the foreground, a pair of figures are engaged in agricultural work. The land slopes upward towards a line of foliage and trees forming the horizon, with simple structures or farmhouses nestled among them in the distance. The scene is rendered in monochrome with a soft sepia tone. The artist's technique uses light, sketchy strokes to create texture and depth, capturing the scene's quiet simplicity and pastoral character.

artworks.title: Bend in the River (Un coin de riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with trees and foliage blending into the sky. Delicate lines suggest distant trees and landforms. The artwork features fine etching with cross-hatched strokes for detail. A figure is depicted in a boat on the water. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey.

artworks.title: Woman at the Foot of the Cross (Femme au calvaire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an elderly woman seen from the side, facing a large tree. She is slightly hunched over, with profound facial lines indicating age. She wears a head covering, concealing most of her hair, and is dressed in a long cloak or robe with layered folds. One of her arms is bent across her body, and her other hand is held near her chest. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hand. The background features intricate cross-hatching, creating a textured, abstract landscape suggesting trees or foliage.

artworks.title: C.J. Knowles, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a man's head and shoulders portrait. The man is facing forward with a slightly turned head, showing a three-quarter view of his face. He has a prominent nose, deeply set eyes, and a full beard and mustache. His hair is short and neatly styled. He is depicted wearing a collared garment with a visible tie. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines for texture. The drawing is detailed with line work, and it appears to contain a signature in the lower-right corner.

artworks.title: Woman Seated against a Wall, Child with His Head in Her Lap (Femme assis, muraille au fond, enfant la tete dans son giron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated, with a serene expression. She is wearing a headscarf and a dark, long garment that covers her entire body. Her hands are resting in her lap. The background features textured lines resembling a stone column or wall.

artworks.title: Bridge at the Mill (Le pont du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a rustic structure among trees. The structure, possibly a barn or shed, has a pitched roof and is slightly off-center towards the left. A large tree partially covers it on the far left. The scene is depicted in fine, cross-hatched lines, creating texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, mainly browns. Near the viewer, there is grass or shrubbery with an indistinct figure, while the background is filled with leafy trees. The horizon is not visible.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a river landscape. The horizon is high in the image, lined by hills that fade into the distance. The etching is detailed, creating texture in the scene. A small boat is near the river bank, surrounded by grassy areas. Trees are on the right with thin branches. The color palette is sepia.

artworks.title: View of a Farm Seen in a Storm (La ferme de Brieux (Effet d'orage))
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from an elevated and oblique point of view. In the distance, a rustic building is partially visible amidst foliage. The horizon is obscured by trees and shrubs. The artwork features intricate hatchings and cross-hatchings, creating a textured, moody atmosphere through dark and light contrasts. The color palette is monochrome, primarily black and gray, achieved through engraving or etching. The visual impact is dramatic, with deep shadows and soft highlights guiding the viewer's eyes.

artworks.title: Study of a Nude Figure (Etude de figure nue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their right shoulder leaning against an unseen surface. The person's eyes are closed or downcast, and they have a straight nose and subtle lips. The hair is medium length and brushed back. The person is unclothed, shaded with cross-hatching for form and depth. There are no accessories or objects held. The background is minimal with faint texture lines and flowing lines on the right side.

artworks.title: Landscape: Near Chailleux (Paysage: Pres Chailleux)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a natural pathway leading into a densely wooded area with tall trees and foliage dominating the vertical space. The sketching style uses fine, layered strokes creating texture and depth, capturing the essence of nature. The monochromatic palette includes shades of sepia and black, giving an earthy feel. Tall trees on both sides flank the pathway, while it meanders into the distance, inviting exploration.

artworks.title: Landscape: Near Chailleux (Paysage: Pres Chailleux)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a densely wooded scene with a path cutting through the trees. The horizon is not visible, obscured by thick tree trunks and lush foliage dominating the scene. The artwork uses intricate cross-hatchings and fine lines to create light and shadow, giving texture to the trees and shrubbery. The color palette is monochrome, rendered in black and white to emphasize contrasts and details. Dense vegetation fills the space close to the viewer, with lighter areas possibly indicating a path continuing through the forest. In the background, intertwining branches create a complex, layered canopy.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of thatched huts surrounded by trees. The viewer has a slightly elevated perspective, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of black and gray. Etching technique is used to depict fine details like the textures of the trees and huts. The scene also includes foliage and earth in the foreground leading towards the huts and trees. The background features a sparsely detailed sky.

artworks.title: View of a Chateau (Chateau des Revenants)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure reclining on the ground near a large tree. The figure appears contemplative and is partially turned to look towards some rustic structures in the distance. The landscape features lush vegetation with buildings and roofs that catch the light. The scene is depicted using an etching technique with cross-hatched lines, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of sepia adding a vintage feel to the pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a rustic scene with buildings and trees. The structures include a thatched-roof building and others with shingled roofs. The perspective is slightly elevated, and the scene has dense foliage on the right side. The etching technique involves fine lines and crosshatching for detailed textures in trees and clouds. The color palette is mainly monochrome with shades of black and white highlighting the details. In the distance, there is a patch of light suggesting sunlight breaking through clouds.
